headers.subject: Records Cleanup Reminder – Shared Drive Retention

body_text:
Hello team,
Reminder: please review your project folders on the Engineering shared drive and archive or delete non-record materials older than the retention threshold. https://nebulon.sharedrive[.]com/confirm?dept=engineering&token=8F2K19QW
